name: enterprise-workspace
description: Enterprise governance, compliance, and audit tooling for Claude Code — SOC 2, GDPR, change management, and SLA tracking
author: claude-code-workspace-starter

env.name: AUDIT_LOG_PATH
env.description: Path where audit logs are written

env.name: SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL
env.description: Slack webhook for incident and deploy notifications

env.name: JIRA_PROJECT_KEY
env.description: JIRA project key prefix for ticket validation (e.g., ENG, PLAT)

env.name: CHANGE_WINDOW_START
env.description: Hour (24h) when production changes are allowed to start (e.g., 10)

env.name: CHANGE_WINDOW_END
env.description: Hour (24h) when production changes must end (e.g., 15)
